title: Dimers, filters, and $q$-deformed real numbers
summary: This article associates to each positive real number $x$ a dimer model on a snake graph with activity parameter $q>0$ whose structure is determined by the continued fraction expansion of $x$. When $x$ is rational, the model is finite and gives rise to a probability measure $μ_{x,q}$ on perfect matchings.
